description: This file defines an abstract class 'BloomFilterBase' which provides a base implementation for Bloom filter data structures, including methods for hashing, insertion, querying, and merging Bloom filters. It is part of the Apache Spark project, specifically within the 'util.sketch' package.

classes.name: BloomFilterBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionalities for Bloom filter implementations, including hashing, equality, merging, and containment checks.

classes.name: HiLoHash
classes.description: A record class representing a pair of hash values (hi and lo) used in hashing functions within the Bloom filter.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on class, hash functions, seed, and bits.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on hash functions, seed, and bits.

methods.name: expectedFpp
methods.description: Calculates the expected false positive probability.

methods.name: bitSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the bit array.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts an object into the Bloom filter, handling different data types.

methods.name: hashLongToIntPair
methods.description: Hashes a long value into a pair of integers for Bloom filter hashing.

methods.name: hashBytesToIntPair
methods.description: Hashes a byte array into a pair of integers for Bloom filter hashing.

methods.name: scatterHashAndSetAllBits
methods.description: Abstract method to hash and set bits in the filter.

methods.name: scatterHashAndGetAllBits
methods.description: Abstract method to hash and check bits in the filter.

methods.name: putString
methods.description: Inserts a string into the Bloom filter.

methods.name: putBinary
methods.description: Inserts a byte array into the Bloom filter.

methods.name: mightContainString
methods.description: Checks if a string might be in the Bloom filter.

methods.name: mightContainBinary
methods.description: Checks if a byte array might be in the Bloom filter.

methods.name: putLong
methods.description: Inserts a long value into the Bloom filter.

methods.name: mightContainLong
methods.description: Checks if a long value might be in the Bloom filter.

methods.name: mightContain
methods.description: Checks if an object (String, byte[], or Long) might be in the filter.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks compatibility with another Bloom filter.

methods.name: mergeInPlace
methods.description: Merges another Bloom filter into this one.

methods.name: intersectInPlace
methods.description: Intersects another Bloom filter with this one.

methods.name: cardinality
methods.description: Returns the number of bits set in the filter.

methods.name: checkCompatibilityForMerge
methods.description: Abstract method to check if another filter can be merged.
